en_title: Exodus Ending and Character Fates Change Based on Your Choices
cn_title: 《Exodus》选择将改变结局与同伴命运
subtitle: 同伴未必同行
opus_summary: 《Exodus》叙事总监Drew Karpyshyn表示，玩家选择会改变同伴关系与结局，部分同伴可能离队。可选内容中的决定还会影响故事发展。游戏将于2027年4月7日登陆PS5、XBOX Series和PC。

paragraphs.en: Any time you look at or talk about Exodus, the upcoming space opera RPG from Archetype Entertainment, the Mass Effect comparisons start flying at light speed. I mean, Exodus narrative director Drew Karpyshyn played a major role as a writer and lead at BioWare to shape the stories of its biggest hits. In our conversation following my hands-on preview of Exodus , he told me that Mass Effect is a perfectly fine way for people to wrap their head around what this new game is.
paragraphs.cn: 每当人们看到或谈起《Exodus》这款由Archetype Entertainment打造的太空歌剧RPG，大家就会以光速将它与《质量效应》相提并论。毕竟，《Exodus》叙事总监Drew Karpyshyn曾在BioWare担任编剧和主创，对该公司几部最大热作的故事塑造发挥了重要作用。在我试玩《Exodus》后的采访中，他告诉我，用《质量效应》来帮助玩家理解这款新作，完全没问题。

paragraphs.en: The parallels don't end with the Paladin/Immortal morality system or the romance and relationship dynamics that are going to drive the story, either. He hinted at how the decisions you make can impact Exodus' ending. Of course, that's not exclusive to BioWare games by any stretch, but when the Mass Effect 2's suicide mission is regarded as a series pinnacle, no one would blame to draw a quick comparison.
paragraphs.cn: 这种相似之处也不止体现在Paladin/Immortal道德系统上，恋爱与关系互动同样会推动故事发展。他还暗示，玩家的决定会影响《Exodus》的结局。当然，这种设计绝非BioWare游戏独有，不过，既然《质量效应2》的「自杀任务」被视为该系列的巅峰，拿两者快速比较一番也无可厚非。

paragraphs.en: When I asked about the relationship systems in Exodus, Karpyshyn emphasized wanting to make them feel real and said it's about, "[M]aking their relationship with you grow, allowing it to evolve from the choices you've made, and realizing that the choices you make are going to bring some companions closer to you, but maybe push some companions farther away."
paragraphs.cn: 当我问到《Exodus》的关系系统时，Karpyshyn强调，他希望这些关系给人真实感，并表示关键在于：「让同伴与你的关系逐渐发展，随着你做出的选择不断变化，同时让你意识到，你的选择会让某些同伴更亲近你，但也可能把另一些同伴推得更远。」

paragraphs.en: He took it one step further, and told me, "Without spoiling too much, we definitely want to have it impact how their storylines go." Then he took it another step further and concluded, "Depending on choices you make, by the end of the game, you might not have every companion with you that you started with. That's about all I can say!"
paragraphs.cn: 他又补充道：「在不剧透太多的前提下，我们确实希望这种关系能够影响他们故事线的发展。」随后，他又进一步说道：「根据你做出的选择，到游戏结束时，你身边可能不会有最初与你同行的所有同伴。我能说的就这么多了！」

paragraphs.en: Those are aspects of an RPG in this style that I would've bet on being included, but it's nice to get confirmation that Exodus is following suit. However, from our conversation it may not seem like it's entirely due to characters facing life-or-death situations. He talked at length about companions butting heads with you and being conflicted about what you say and the actions you take in key moments.
paragraphs.cn: 这些都是我原本就料到这类RPG会包含的元素，不过，能确认《Exodus》也会采用类似设计，还是很不错的。不过，从我们的谈话来看，这些内容似乎并不完全是因为角色会面对生死关头。他详细谈到，同伴可能会与你发生冲突，也可能因你在关键时刻说了什么、做了什么而陷入矛盾。

paragraphs.en: He expanded on how other in-game events can factor into how the story unfolds, saying, "Even within that optional content, there are choices that will lock or unlock certain things, change the way things play out, change relationships, change characters, change… future… missions…" Hmm, smells like loyalty missions to me!
paragraphs.cn: 他进一步解释了游戏中的其他事件如何影响故事展开，并说道：「即使是在那些可选内容中，也会有一些选择锁定或解锁特定内容，改变事情的发展方式，改变关系，改变角色，改变……未来的……任务……」嗯，听起来很像忠诚任务！

paragraphs.en: Perhaps companions can reach a breaking point and leave the party entirely. And maybe their affinity toward you or the situations they face throughout the story will impact their survival in the end.
paragraphs.cn: 或许，同伴可能会走到决裂的地步，彻底离开队伍。又或者，他们对你的好感度，或是整个故事中所处的境遇，会影响他们最终能否活下来。

paragraphs.en: We'll know for sure when Exodus launches on April 7, 2027 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. For more on the upcoming sci-fi RPG, be sure to check out my hands-on preview for Exodus and read my full interview with Drew Karpyshyn .
paragraphs.cn: 等《Exodus》于2027年4月7日登陆PS5、XBOX Series和PC，我们就能确定答案了。
